required_changes_injected: FAIL: Criterion 4 (Actionable Next Steps). Economic Buyer next step uses vague language: 'Ask the primary contact on the next call (name unknown)' — this violates the requirement that next steps must have a specific contact name or '[contact TBD]' placeholder with a concrete action. The phrasing 'Ask...on the next call' is too vague without naming who will be asked. Rewrite as: '[contact TBD]: Confirm budget owner identity and title by asking: Who owns the budget for experimentation tooling — is that someone on the CRO team, or does this require VP/CFO sign-off?' ALSO FAIL: Criterion 2 (Carry-forward Consistency). Economic Buyer regressed from 4/10 to 2/10 without sufficient justification. The analysis claims the prior 4/10 'overstated' the evidence, but the cumulative state explicitly noted 'CRO team of 10 mentioned as users and decision influencers' — 'decision influencers' is not the same as 'users only.' The downgrade requires either: (a) explicit evidence from Call 3 contradicting the prior assessment, or (b) acknowledgment that the prior 4/10 was an error in the cumulative state itself. The analysis does not provide Call 3 evidence that contradicts 'decision influencers.' Rewrite the Economic Buyer score note to either: justify the downgrade with specific Call 3 contradictions, or maintain 4/10 and note 'No new EB information in Call 3 — maintaining previous score of 4/10 based on CRO team as decision influencers.' Champion has the same issue: regressed from 3/10 to 2/10 with the claim that 'team buy-in needed' means no champion exists — but Call 1 and Call 2 do not contradict the prior 3/10; Call 3 adds no new evidence either. Maintain 3/10 or provide explicit Call 3 evidence of regression.
